title: What a $4,900 home robot actually looks like
caption:
Unitree's R1 starts at $4,900 and ships from existing stock — no waitlist, no pre-order, available to order today.

Most consumer robotics products have been gated by cost or lead time. The R1 clears both barriers simultaneously: a sub-$5,000 price point and immediate fulfillment — a combination that hasn't existed in this category before.

At that price, a capable personal robot companion falls into the same budget as a used car. That's the threshold that has historically marked the start of mainstream adoption for new hardware categories.
